description:
A set of Android widgets (KWGT, 4×2 format) that let you
  see at a glance whether it’s worth bringing out your
  telescope: sky rating, optimal viewing window, darkness
  levels, Moon phase, cloud cover, atmospheric
  stability—plus suggestions on what to observe and where to
  look.

  They work anywhere; you simply need to set your
  observation location, and they can automatically track
  your phone’s position as you move around.
name: Widget astro Alnitak
releaseNotes: Phone geolocation and recalculation of weather and astronomical data whenever the phone is more than 20 km away from the La Martyre observation site.
